propositions: sign_manifest validates signing against store-wide git HEAD instead of subject's own generation, causing false retries whenever unrelated tickets commit during the attempt

the before/after HEAD fence (site A) and locked_head/expected_after disjunct (site B) compare whole-tracker state that moves every ~3s under normal churn, exhausting all 3 retry attempts within a single contention episode
tracker_head_sha classifies a peer writer's index-only staged entries (normal `git add` → `git commit` footprint under lock) as fatal store-read-failure instead of clean state

affected tickets remain permanently unclaimable because sign-review fails every attempt while concurrent writes land, violating the documented contract that signing scopes to subject/related material only
the regression test freezes tracker_head_sha to a constant, preventing the store-wide fence from being observed and leaving it untested against live concurrent commits
